drawings.description: en haut à gauche, un croquis : deux points reliés par trois arcs $\Gamma'_1$, $\Gamma'_3$, $\Gamma'_2$, les régions $V_2$, $V_1$ entre eux et $V_3$ à l'extérieur, un petit cercle orienté autour de chaque point
drawings.kind: two points joined by three arcs
drawings.notes: Two points joined by three arcs, with the regions V_2, V_1 between them and V_3 outside, and a small oriented circle around each point. The arc labels follow the transcription (Gamma'_1, Gamma'_3, Gamma'_2 from left to right); on the page the right-hand label's index looks like a 1 written over, and is placed as the transcription reads it.

drawings.description: à gauche, un croquis tracé la feuille tournée d'un quart de tour : deux régions arrondies accolées, limitées par trois arcs qui joignent deux points — $\Gamma'_1$ à gauche, $\Gamma'_2$ à droite et l'arc médian $\Gamma'_3$ ; le point du haut est entouré d'un petit cercle, celui du bas est noté $y$ ; quatre longs traits obliques hachurent l'ensemble.
drawings.kind: two regions bounded by three arcs joining two points, small circle round one of them, hatching
drawings.notes: The sketch was drawn with the sheet turned by a quarter turn (its labels read upright when the scan is turned 90 degrees clockwise); the crop is turned that way and the figure redrawn with its labels upright. The three arcs start and end at the same two computed points: the upper one, inside the small circle, and the lower one, labelled y. Labels Gamma'_1 (left, outside), Gamma'_2 (right, outside), Gamma'_3 (beside the median arc). Inside the small circle a small letter (x, as on p. 13) at the upper left and an inked blot at the right; the blot is not drawn. The hatching is four long oblique strokes, drawn as on the page (two end in a hook), and two short dotted arcs. Decided by a machine pass, 2026-11-12: the subscripts of the two outer labels are read 1 (left) and 2 (right) -- the strokes are small, but the text of the page names exactly Gamma'_1, Gamma'_2, Gamma'_3 and the figure of p. 13 has the same layout. Not checked by a reader. The transcription's note (« deux cercles sécants ») describes the same figure; the two outlines are not circles that cross but two lobes sharing the median arc. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.orientation: sketch drawn with the sheet turned: crop rotated 90 degrees clockwise, labels upright

drawings.description: à gauche, une figure : trois régions arrondies accolées, séparées par trois lignes qui partent d'un même nœud ; près du nœud les trois branches sont épaissies, leurs extrémités marquées $B_1$, $B_2$, $B_3$ et leurs milieux $C_1$, $C_2$, $C_3$ ; sous la figure, « $K$ ».
drawings.kind: three regions round a triple node with thickened branches
drawings.notes: As on the page: three lobes whose outlines meet two by two at three points; from each of these a thin line runs inwards to the end of a heavy branch, and the three heavy branches meet at one node. Every outline and line is drawn between the same computed points. Labels B_1, B_2, B_3 at the outer ends of the heavy branches and C_1, C_2, C_3 beside them, K under the figure. Left out: two small ticks across the thin line of the upper left. Agrees with the transcription's note. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche, la figure : deux grands arcs $\Gamma'_1$ (à gauche) et $\Gamma'_2$ (à droite) et l'arc médian $\Gamma'_3$, qui se rejoignent en haut et en bas ; autour du point du haut, un petit cercle découpé par les trois arcs en trois secteurs notés $v_1$, $v_2$, $v_3$.
drawings.kind: three arcs joining two points, small circle round the upper one cut into three sectors
drawings.notes: As on the page: the three arcs drawn from the same upper point to the same lower point; the small circle round the upper point (an ellipse fitted to his outline); the sector labels v_3 (top), v_2 (lower left), v_1 (lower right); the labels Gamma'_1 (on the left arc, at the top), Gamma'_2 (outside the right arc, at the upper right), Gamma'_3 (right of the median arc). The upper point is not lettered on the figure (the note of the transcription calls it x after the text). Left out: an inked blot inside the small circle (a struck letter) and the bracket of the text at the right. Agrees with the transcription's note. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en haut à gauche, un croquis : un triangle aux côtés épais ; sur sa base deux points $x$ et $y$, chacun relié au sommet opposé par un trait fin, le premier marqué $1$, le second $2$ ; le trait issu de $y$ dépasse un peu la base vers le bas.
drawings.kind: triangle with two points on its base joined to the apex
drawings.notes: As on the page: the triangle (heavy sides), the points x and y computed on its base and labelled under it, a thin line from each to the apex (the one from x is drawn two or three times over on the page; one line here), the one from y running on a little below the base. The two marks beside the thin lines are small and partly struck over; they are given as 1 and 2 after the transcription. Disagreement with the transcription's note in part: it says the two arcs marked 1 and 2 join x and y; on the page each goes from its point on the base to the opposite vertex. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.disagreement: The note says two arcs marked 1 and 2 join x and y; on the page each thin line goes from its point of the base to the opposite vertex.

drawings.description: plus bas, deux dessins sans lettres : à gauche un polygone non convexe en dents de scie, à quinze côtés environ ; à droite un petit triangle dont le côté inférieur est tracé en pointillé, avec un point au-dessus et un point au-dessous de ce côté.
drawings.kind: non-convex saw-tooth polygon; small triangle with one dotted side and two points
drawings.notes: Left: the saw-tooth polygon, closed, drawn through its vertices as read (fifteen of them; the long side at the lower right is slightly curved on the page and is drawn as a curve). Right: the small triangle, its lower side dotted, and the two points, one inside above that side and one below it. No letters. Agrees with the transcription's note. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

figures.what: small triangle with a dotted side

drawings.description: sans texte : un seul dessin, à l'encre noire, en haut à gauche — un polygone étoilé non convexe au trait épais, doublé par endroits d'un second contour parallèle, plus fin, à l'intérieur de sa branche gauche et à l'extérieur de ses pointes du bas.
drawings.kind: non-convex star polygon, partly doubled by a thinner parallel contour
drawings.notes: The heavy polygon, closed, through its twelve vertices as read; the thin second contour in two pieces, as on the page: one inside the left branch (from the upper left tip down, across to the inner peak and down again), one outside the two lower points (down the left, across, down to the lowest tip and up the right). Left out: a small loop of the thin line at the left of the upper left branch and three small strokes at the right, by the vertex where the thin line ends. Still differs: on the page the heavy line is very thick along the left branch (a filled wedge) and the thin contour is a free doubling whose joins with the heavy line are approximate here. Decided by a machine pass, 2026-11-12: the thin line is read as a second outline of the same polygon, not as a second polygon; either way the figure is a non-convex star polygon without letters. Not checked by a reader. The transcription's note says the second contour is inside; it is inside along the left branch and outside at the bottom. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: sans texte : un croquis à l'encre noire — un segment épais d'extrémités $s$ (en bas à gauche) et $s'$ (en haut à droite), un point $y$ sur ce segment, et une ligne en tirets qui monte de $y$ jusqu'à un point, à côté duquel est tracée une croix (le point $x$).
drawings.kind: segment s s-prime, a point y on it, dashed line to a point x
drawings.notes: As on the page: the heavy segment between s and s', the point y computed on it with its label at the left, the dashed line rising from y to a full point, and the small cross drawn just right of that point (his mark for x; no letter x is written). Labels s and s' at the ends. Agrees with the transcription's note. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: page de croquis, sans ordre, autour du texte écrit en travers. À l'encre noire : en haut, un polygone en pointe de flèche dont un creux est fermé en tirets, sous un trait isolé ; au milieu, deux polygones en dents de scie dont les creux sont fermés en pointillé ; plus bas, deux quadrilatères contenant chacun une étoile à quatre branches en tirets, appuyée sur leurs sommets ; en dessous, un petit triangle $s$, $s'$, $s''$ avec une ligne pointillée de $s$ vers un point $t$, et un polygone non convexe portant $s$, $s'$, $s''$ et $t$, une verticale en tirets descendant de $s$ vers $t$. Au crayon, pâles : de longs triangles effilés, trois petits triangles surchargés en haut à droite, un polygone en dents de scie et un triangle hachuré en bas.
drawings.kind: page of sketches: non-convex polygons with their hulls dotted, stars inside quadrilaterals
drawings.notes: Only the seven ink figures are redrawn, each closed through its vertices as read: (1) top, the arrowhead polygon with the dashed stroke closing its notch, and the isolated stroke above it; (2) middle left, a saw-tooth polygon with a dotted stroke over its upper notch and a dashed one closing its lower notch, the horizontal side running on a little to the right; (3) middle, the larger saw-tooth polygon, its upper left notch closed by a dotted stroke ending at a heavy point, a second heavy point at the next tooth, the bottom closed by a dashed stroke; (4), (5) the two quadrilaterals, each with a dashed four-pointed star on its four vertices; (6) the small triangle s, s', s'' (two heavy sides from s) with the dotted line from s to the mark read t; (7) the non-convex polygon with s at the tip of its notch, s' and s'' at the foot of the notch, joined by a dotted stroke, and the dashed vertical from s down to the point t. Left out: all the pencil sketches (the long thin triangles, the three small overworked triangles at the upper right, the saw-tooth polygon and the hatched triangle at the bottom, a pencil label near figure 3), a small arrow-shaped polygon drawn inside the upper teeth of figure 3, and the text written across the sheet. Still differs: the teeth at the top of figure 3 and the inner vertices of the two stars are approximate; in figure 5 a small zigzag near the top vertex is not drawn. Decided by a machine pass, 2026-11-12: the mark at the end of the dotted line of figure 6 is read t, as the letter at the foot of figure 7 (same shape; the text across the page speaks of s, s', s'' and t). Not checked by a reader. The transcription's note mentions two drawings only (the pencil saw-tooth polygon in a large triangle and the ink arrowhead polygon); the page carries about a dozen. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche, un dessin : un polygone non convexe à sept côtés, en éclair, sans lettres.
drawings.notes: The polygon, closed, through its seven vertices as read; the lower left side is very slightly bent on the page and is drawn straight. No letters. Disagreement with the transcription's note: it says six sides; seven are counted on the page. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.disagreement: The note says « à six côtés »; the polygon has seven sides.
